narration.text: I tested 40 AI tools for YouTube Shorts. Only 5 survived.
Coming in at number 5, Opus Clip. This tool turns your long videos into engaging short clips using smart AI. It is fantastic for repurposing content and saving hours of editing time.
Next up, number 4, Submagic. It adds dynamic captions and B-roll to your shorts, making them truly viral-ready. Your content will stand out and grab attention immediately.
At number 3, we have Pictory. This AI creates entire shorts from your text scripts in just minutes. It is perfect if you are camera-shy but still want high-quality video content.
Our runner-up at number 2 is VidIQ. This tool offers AI-powered insights for finding viral topics and keywords. It is like having a marketing expert in your pocket, guiding your content strategy.

And the undisputed champion at number 1 is Descript. This all-in-one platform is a video editor, script writer, and recorder. It is incredibly versatile and powerful, a true game-changer for creators.
Descript is the best all-rounder by far. What is your go-to AI tool for YouTube Shorts?
